I teach quantitative methods, causal inference, machine learning, and American politics. I am especially interested in helping students connect modern statistical tools to real research questions in political science and the social sciences.

## Instructor Positions

-   Harvard University, Lecturer in Political Methodology: [GOV 50 Data Science for the Social Sciences](https://samjfuller.github.io/gov50-f26/); GOV 51 Data Analysis and Politics; GOV 2018 Applied Machine Learning (PhD class) (2026)

-   ICPSR Summer Program, Topical Workshop: [Causal Machine Learning for Observational and Experimental Research](content/ICPSR_Causal_Machine_Learning_Syllabus_2026.pdf) (2025-26, with Jack T. Rametta)
